text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is in a picture, such as a cat or a tree. Another key task is object detection, which finds and locates multiple objects in an image at the same time. These technologies have many applications in our daily lives. For example, self-driving cars use computer vision to see the road, recognize traffic signs, and detect pedestrians. Computer vision is also used in security cameras, medical imaging, and facial recognition on smartphones. It is changing the way machines interact with the world.
